description: The Crossroads is a paved central refuge arranged around a stone fireplace and a circle of orange upholstered seats. Four distinctive portals surround the space: a blue mechanical ring to the left, a fiery frontier arch at the upper left, a blue fantasy arch on the upper right and a warm amber doorway on the right. A small shop with stocked shelves and colourful goods fills the lower-right corner. On the lower left, a bright green cylinder marked with a heart stands on a circular pad. Plants, lanterns and autumn-coloured branches soften the enclosing stonework. The portals, hearth and shop make this both a meeting place and the junction between Home and the adventure regions.
